creatives.design_prompt:
Create a premium Lavendish Leisure Facebook and Instagram feed design in 4:5 portrait format, exactly 1080 × 1350 px. If appropriate, build a cohesive 5–7 slide carousel: one clear idea per slide, consistent purple shading, and the website CTA only on the final slide.

PAGE: Lavendish Leisure Main Page
CONTENT TYPE: Hotel discovery
LINKED CAMPAIGN: None — editorial/always-on content
SUBJECT: Understand one real Lavendish hotel — rooms, facilities and ideal guest
FEATURED HOTEL / DESTINATION: Portfolio rotation
REQUIRED REAL ASSET: Real-photo carousel / single image

AUTHENTICITY: Use only supplied, verified, high-resolution real photographs belonging to the named hotel or clearly identified destination. Preserve real architecture, rooms, pools, landscape, food, people and proportions. Do not create, replace or reconstruct any hotel, beach, wildlife, guest, staff member, food item or destination scene with AI. Never present a nearby attraction as part of the hotel. When hotel and attraction images appear together, separate them by slide or a clear editorial divider and label the attraction “Nearby [Place]”. Use only verified real assets. Keep hotel and nearby attraction imagery clearly labelled and visually separated.

LAVENDISH PURPLE SAMPLE PATTERN: Keep the authentic full-bleed photograph as the hero. Add a refined transparent purple atmosphere rising from the lower 28–38% of the composition. Blend softly from #DEBAD8 and #A989BF into a deeper translucent navy-purple derived from #243E5D. Feather the upper edge into the photograph so texture remains visible; never use a hard rectangular purple banner. A very light lavender veil may unify the upper image only when needed. Use #FFFFFF or #243E5D for text according to contrast and #F9EFF6 for restrained detail. #B5DDBA may appear only sparingly when the official logo is present. Avoid neon purple, heavy borders, clutter, excessive effects and large empty areas.

LOGO & TYPE: Place the supplied official Lavendish Leisure Hotels & Resorts logo unchanged, proportional and with clear space. Never redraw, retype, recolour or distort it. The logo artwork retains Adobe Garamond Pro. Use Montserrat Light for editorial headlines/subheads and Roboto Light for body/CTA.

EXACT ARTWORK COPY
Headline: “Understand one real Lavendish hotel”
Subheadline: “A distinct Lavendish stay.”
CTA: “Explore & Book Online”
Website: “lavendishleisure.com”

COMPOSITION: Protect the strongest area of the photograph. Use a premium editorial hierarchy, controlled spacing and fine divider lines only when useful. Keep logo and copy inside generous mobile-safe margins. The result should feel like a sophisticated international hotel-chain campaign while remaining unmistakably Lavendish.
creatives.caption:
Every Lavendish hotel has its own character. Understand one real Lavendish hotel — rooms, facilities and ideal guest. Discover the authentic spaces, atmosphere and thoughtful details that make Portfolio rotation part of a memorable Sri Lankan journey.

Explore hotels, current availability and booking details at www.lavendishleisure.com.
